The '''EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate''', also known as the '''Nebulon-B frigate''', was a class of [[frigate]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards]]. Despite being intended for [[Imperial Navy]] service, it gained more fame as a '''Rebel Cruiser''' used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and its successor, the [[New Republic]], throughout the [[Galactic Civil War]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Anti-starfighter? You're not kidding! These things are a couple of generations from new, but it's pretty common for one to be packing a dozen laser cannons, a dozen turbolasers, AND a couple of missile launchers. No thanks.|Poe Dameron|<ref name="Rebel Files" />}}
[[File:Nebulon-B_bridge.png|thumb|left|250px|The bridge of a Nebulon-B frigate.]]
The EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate was an escort [[frigate]] manufactured with a highly versatile design platform that allowed it to function in several different capacities as part of a [[fleet]].<ref name="USW" /> The vessels featured a propulsion module that housed 7 aft-mounted [[ion engine]]s connected to the forward blade-like body by a thin, cylindrical [[hull]] section. The propulsion module also contained the ship's [[deflector shield generator]] situated at the top of the craft. A primary long-range [[communications array]] protruded from the top of the craft,<ref name="Starfighters" /> while the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] was located halfway down the [[Starship|ship's]] fore. The bridge contained a [[holoprojector]], at least four crew stations, and a primary command station.<ref name="Zero Hour">{{Rebels|Zero Hour}}</ref> These vessels also contained a command center and [[hangar]] bays capable of housing [[light freighter]]s,<ref name="SW4">[[Star Wars (2015) 4|''Star Wars'' (2015) 4]]</ref> several [[shuttle]]s, and a [[squadron]] of [[starfighter]]s.<ref name="Starfighters" /> Heavily armed, a Nebulon-B carried twelve [[turbolaser]] and twelve [[laser cannon]]s, with the main weapons of each installed on the bottom edge of the ship's forward hull. It also carried powerful dual [[tractor beam]]s.<ref name="USW" />

Many Nebulon-B frigates were utilized as [[Hospital ship|medical frigates]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and were equipped with [[bacta tank]]s, [[medical droid]]s, and full-service [[Medcenter|hospital]] facilities.<ref name="USW" /> The main medical bay on a Nebulon-B could hold up to 700 patients, and was located at the highest module at the bow of the starship. Docking tubes were located on the connecting neck between both sections of the frigate.<ref name="Starfighters" />

Though the frigate itself proved hardy in combat, the long spar that connected the two hull sections of the ship was a weakness and vulnerable to concentrated fire. Should this occur the frigate would be split in two, venting atmosphere from both sections.<ref name="Rogue One" />

==Role==
{{Quote|They're heading for the medical frigate!|[[Wedge Antilles]] during the Battle of Endor|<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
Boasting a highly versatile design platform, the Nebulon-B frigate served in a range of capacities, although was typically utilized as an escort frigate. The Rebel Alliance deployed these frigates to protect [[transport]] convoys from [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] attacks or [[pirate]] raids, although some were modified for long-range scouting or search-and-rescue operations. However, the Nebulon-B became most famous for its use as Rebel medical frigates, and many were equipped with full-service hospital facilities.<ref name="USW" /> In addition to its medical roles, the frigates could be used for search and rescue tasks, [[scout]]ing operations, combat missions,<ref name="Starfighters" /> anti-starfighter roles, [[Orbital bombardment|bombardment]], serving as a [[carrier]],<ref name="Rebel Files" /> and as an escort.<ref name="USW" />

==History==
[[File:Vanguard_Nebulon-B.png|thumb|left|220px|The ''Vanguard'' with the Massassi Group.]]
The EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate was created by [[Kuat Drive Yards]],<ref name="USW" /> for the [[Imperial Navy]],<ref name="TLJ Cross-sections" /> although they were more commonly used by rebel cells<ref name="Tarkin" /> of the formative<ref name="Secret Cargo">{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}}</ref> Alliance to Restore the Republic against the Galactic Empire. Nebulon-B frigates were often used as [[convoy]] escorts.<ref name="USW" /> [[Berch Teller]] and his [[Berch Teller's rebel cell|cell]] utilized a Nebulon-B to [[Battle near the Gulf of Tatooine|attack]] a convoy containing the [[hyperdrive]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] around five [[Standard year|years]] after the end of the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Tarkin" /> Several of the frigates were part of the fleet which assembled over [[Dantooine]] in response to [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance|declaration]] of rebellion in [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Secret Cargo" /> and three were fielded by [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]]'s [[Massassi Group]] during the [[Battle of Atollon]]. All of them, including Dodonna's flagship the ''[[Vanguard]]'', were destroyed by [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] and his [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]].<ref name="Zero Hour" />

[[Admiral]] [[Raddus]] had at least three Nebulon-B escort frigates in his fleet when [[Rogue One]] went to [[Scarif]] to steal the [[Death Star plans]], and participated in the subsequent [[Battle of Scarif|battle]]. At its conclusion, at least one frigate successfully managed to escape into hyperspace, but another was destroyed and split in half under heavy fire from [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] [[Star Destroyer]], ''[[Devastator]]''.<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

[[File:RebelFleet-2015StarWars23.png|thumb|right|250px|A Nebulon-B frigate was the temporary headquarters for the rebel leadership]]
Following the [[Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Evacuation of Yavin 4|evacuation]] of [[Yavin 4]], the [[Alliance High Command|Rebel leadership]] maintained a constantly-moving fleet, keeping on the run while seeking a new base of operations, and utilized a Nebulon-B as their temporary headquarters ship during this period. From here, Mothma, Dodonna, Admiral [[Gial Ackbar]], and others planned operations against the Empire after the [[Assault on Cymoon]]. [[Han Solo]] recuperated aboard while repairing the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' with [[Chewbacca]], and [[Luke Skywalker]] briefly trained in one of the frigate's chambers before departing for [[Tatooine]].<ref name="SW4" /> Solo and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] later departed on a scouting mission to secure a new base,<ref name="SW5">[[Star Wars (2015) 5|''Star Wars'' (2015) 5]]</ref> leaving the Rebel leaders to discuss Skywalker's troubling activities in the ship's command center. Although Mothma was unable to commit any forces to assist Skywalker on [[Nar Shaddaa]], Chewbacca and [[C-3PO]] volunteered to help their friend.<ref name="SW9">[[Star Wars (2015) 9|''Star Wars'' (2015) 9]]</ref> Sometime later, the Rebel leadership met with Organa and Skywalker in the command center, and tasked them with a [[Siege on Tureen VII|mission]] to [[Tureen VII]], leading the pair to embark on a mission to [[Hijacking of the Harbinger|steal]] a [[Harbinger (Imperial I-class)|Star Destroyer]].<ref name="SW23">[[Star Wars (2015) 23|''Star Wars'' (2015) 23]]</ref> As of the [[time]] of the [[mission to rescue C-3PO]], the Nebulon-B was part of a much larger contingent of the Rebel fleet.<ref name="SW26">[[Star Wars (2015) 26|''Star Wars'' (2015) 26]]</ref>

As of [[3 ABY]], the Nebulon-B frigate ''[[Redemption]]'' served as a medical ship for the Rebel Alliance. Following the [[Battle of Hoth]], the ''Redemption'', the ''Tyvarex'', and another Nebulon-B were assigned to the fleet's Fourth Division in accordance with the Alliance's scatter protocol. The Fourth Division retreated to Rendezvous Point Delta-Three, only to be ambushed by an Imperial fleet and blockaded against a star. The ''Tyvarex'' was destroyed under heavy fire, but the ''Redemption'' and the other Nebulon-B were able to escape thanks to the timely arrival of the ''Millennium Falcon''.<ref name="Star Wars 1">[[Star Wars (2020) 1|''Star Wars'' (2020) 1]]</ref> Luke Skywalker was then treated aboard the medical frigate for injuries received during his [[Duel on Cloud City|confrontation]] with [[Darth]] Vader on [[Cloud City]].<ref name="ESB" />

[[File:RebelTroopers-2020StarWars8.png|thumb|left|300px|Rebel soldiers aboard a Nebulon-B during the [[battle at Elessia]] face down a coming Imperial boarding.]]
During [[Operation Yellow Moon]], the Nebulon-B frigate ''[[Remembrance]]'', commanded by [[Captain]] [[Volk Aymeric]], served as the lead vessel in a convoy of [[Starship|ships]] that protected [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], one of the leaders of the Alliance.<ref name="Moving Target">''[[Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure]]''</ref>

At least two Nebulon-B frigates were part of the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Rebel fleet]] at the [[Battle of Endor]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> with the ''Redemption'' fighting alongside other rebel warships and drawing heavy enemy fire.<ref name="Starfighters" /> At least one frigate survived to join [[Rebel Fleet Command]] at [[Muster Point: Vergence]], twenty days after [[Endor]],<ref name="Shattered Empire II">[[Shattered Empire 2|''Shattered Empire'' 2]]</ref> and later at [[Muster Point: Stalwart]].<ref name="Shattered Empire IV">[[Shattered Empire 4|''Shattered Empire'' 4]]</ref>

Numerous Nebulon-B frigates went on to serve in the [[New Republic]].<ref name="Battlefront" /> At the [[Battle of Jakku]], [[Commodore]] [[Kyrsta Agate]] witnessed a Nebulon-B break in half under heavy fire but continuing to unleash its full complement of weapons at a Star Destroyer nonetheless.<ref name="Empire's End">''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]''</ref> Another Nebulon-B later crashed into the [[flagship]] of Admiral [[Garrick Versio]], the ''Eviscerator'', further compromising the already crumbling ship's integrity.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

[[File:Opportunity_Nebulon-B.png|thumb|right|220px|The ''Opportunity'' was used by Jinata Security]]
At least one Nebulon-B, going by the name of [[Opportunity (Nebulon-B)|''Opportunity'']], served under the banner of [[Jinata Security]], a [[law enforcement agency]] based on the [[planet]] [[Vardos]] in the [[Jinata system]]. [[Captain]]ed by [[Leema Kai]] and painted in the colors of Jinata Security, the ship assisted the [[First Order]] in implementing [[Project Resurrection]] across the Jinata system by kidnapping children and conscripting them to become First Order [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]]. Whilst preparing to resume this operation on [[Athulla]], the ''Opportunity'', and its modified [[GR-75 medium transport|GR-75]] escorts were [[Mission to Athulla|accosted]] by [[Iden Versio]] and her daughter [[Zay Versio]] who had been led there after finding that [[Del Meeko]]'s ship ''Corvus'' had been investigating the kidnappings on behalf of the Resistance. The frigate deployed fighters and fled deeper into Athulla's [[asteroid field]] in an attempt to lose them, but the two women took out its escorts and crippled the ship by destroying the engines. Whilst Iden battled with Kai, Zay contacted the ''Opportunity'' and tricked them into surrendering by threatening to unleash a barrage of non-existent [[concussion missile]]s on it. The ship's crew, believing them, not only surrendered the ''Opportunity'' but gave up all the information they had on Project Resurrection.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="TROS Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] to one [[Standard year|year]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. As ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''The Force Awakens'' to [[34 ABY]], the events of ''The Rise of Skywalker'' must occur in [[35 ABY]].</ref> Nebulon-B frigates were part of a [[Citizens' Fleet|fleet]] assembled by [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] to assist the Resistance during the [[Battle of Exegol|battle]] against the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] over the [[planet]] [[Exegol]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Behind the scenes==
The EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], released in [[1980]].<ref name="ESB" /> Its full name was identified in the reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' in [[2015]].<ref name="USW" />

In [[2016]], the ship appeared in the [[Star Wars (2015)|Star Wars comic]] issue [[Star Wars (2015) 23|''Star Wars'' (2015) 23]]<ref name="SW23" /> in a shot similar to its [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] appearance in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>

The model's nickname, the Nebulon-B frigate, was revealed in another reference book, the ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'', in [[2017]].<ref name="SW:TVE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
